does: Registers the interface type ls.LSVideoPanel with the dependency properties Video and AutoPlay and the routed commands PlayCommand and StopCommand.

evidence.says: creates the type under the text ls.LSVideoPanel, registers two properties under the texts Video and AutoPlay and creates routed commands under the texts PlayCommand and StopCommand

questions.ask: Open a widget whose XAML holds an ls:LSVideoPanel and see the element created.
